assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md lines 5-14 show a 'Configuration Used (from CLAUDE.md → Project Configuration / Security Configuration)' table mapping Project key `TC` -> `project = TC` and Vulnerability issue type ID `10024` -> `issuetype = 10024`; all three queries (lines 20, 25, 30) use `project = TC AND issuetype = 10024`.

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md Query 1 (line 20): 'labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)'; Query 2 (line 25): 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New'; Query 3 (line 30): 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, 'ON_QA')'.

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md headings separated by '---': '## 1. Untriaged (4 issues)' (line 40), '## 2. Triaged but still New (1 issue)' (line 62), '## 3. Ready for QA (1 issue)' (line 74).

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertion_results.evidence: Tables in discovery-listing.md have columns 'Issue | Status | CVE | Summary | Created' for all listed issues, e.g. line 46 'TC-9001 | New | CVE-2026-40112 | h2 - HTTP/2 rapid reset vulnerability [rhtpa-2.2] | 2026-06-08', line 70 TC-9010, line 80 TC-9020 '| Modified | CVE-2026-38901 | hyper - HTTP request smuggling [rhtpa-2.2] | 2026-05-15'.

assertion_results.text: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertion_results.evidence: status-handling.md summary table lines 16-18: TC-9001/TC-9002/TC-9004 'New | Proceed with full triage'; line 19 TC-9003 'In Progress | Warn + ask (proceed / skip)'; line 38 warning '"This issue is already in `In Progress`. It may be actively worked on."'; discovery-listing.md line 56 also notes TC-9003 may be actively worked on.

assertion_results.text: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md line 80: TC-9020 listed in Ready for QA with 'TC-9021 (Done), TC-9022 (Closed)'; excluded table line 88: 'TC-9023 ... TC-9025 (Task) still In Progress'; line 89: 'TC-9026 ... No linked Tasks with link type "Depend"'.
